name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 43 hours starting 2026-04-30, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 4.19 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
